title: Easy-to-Hard Probe Generalization Across Difficulty Quantiles

original_idea.body:
# Easy-to-Hard Probe Generalization Across Difficulty Quantiles

Bin questions by difficulty, train probes on easiest, measure AUROC decay on harder bins.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: easy-to-hard probe transfer is the empirical crux of scalable oversight/ELK.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Reuses public datasets, linear probes, difficulty binning; accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped decay-curve experiment varying only difficulty gap.

low_compute.reasoning: Probing on open model, single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: elk-generalization covers easy-to-hard; the fine decay-curve-vs-graded-difficulty may be partially open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Easy-to-hard is studied; the fine-grained decay curve may be open.
